title: M34 — upper suite direct-link spatial screen
status: design gate; one room shift is insufficient to realize the owner-directed private sequence
coordinate_basis: Upper room blocks use the source-documented wing-local shell; translate upper y by its recorded plan_frame_offsets_ft value only when comparing with shared-frame core geometry.
assumptions: The selected-D 0.5 ft block separation is retained as a nominal wall allowance, not a verified wall thickness.
The current 4 ft C-UPPER and 8x8 ft lift reservation are treated as comparison geometry, not approved construction dimensions.
A private direct connection is represented by U-02 and U-03 meeting across the nominal 0.5 ft wall zone; no door or opening is modeled.
open_findings: Current U-03 overlaps the shared-frame lift reservation in plan projection after applying the documented +6 ft upper-frame offset. Confirm whether the reservation is intended to persist at this location before resolving the upper plan.

Moving U-03 west to align with U-02 across the nominal wall zone occupies part of existing C-UPPER and overlaps the projected lift reservation; this is a diagnostic, not a proposed approved placement.

Preserving a private U-02-to-U-03 route, guest access, U-03/U-04 Jack-and-Jill connection, the 4 ft public hall and lift reservation requires a broader upper-floor/core re-layout. No room-size, core or shell change is authorized by this screen.
limitations: No feasible alternate packing is asserted. The test establishes that the single direct shift does not work with current corridor/lift rectangles.
No wall, door, door swing, furniture, headroom, floor opening, shaft, stair, service or life-safety geometry is modeled.
No Revit or IFC action was performed; no code, accessibility, structural or construction claim is made.
